_comment: Repairs and upgrades done at the Shipwright's Anvil (see upgrade/Upgrades.java). Change the numbers here, or add
a new upgrade by copying one: the Shipwright's Manual's Upgrades chapter is written from this file.
repair_share = how much of an item's durability one piece of its head material mends (0.25 = a quarter).
slots = how many upgrade levels each kind of gear holds. Every level of an upgrade takes one slot.
Upgrades: fits = katana, weapon (cutlasses, sabres, axes, jittes, kanabo, spears), melee (both), gun,
hat, coat, sash, boots, armor (all four and gauntlets), shield, gauntlets, or any; or several joined with commas
("gun,armor"). item = what you hold in your offhand to add a level (an item id, or #tag), count = how many of it
each level takes. grand = true: only a Grand Line Anvil can add it.
Effects (per level). An effect with only (same values as fits) works only on that gear, for an upgrade that fits several:
attribute: attribute id, amount, operation (add_value, add_multiplied_base or add_multiplied_total).
durability: amount = share of the item's durability added (0.2 = +20%).
gun_damage: amount = damage added to every shot. gun_range: share added. gun_reload: share taken off the
reload. gun_spread: share taken off the spread.
haki_pierce: amount = share of a hit that goes through armor while your Armament Haki is switched on.
block_thorns: amount = damage a raised shield deals back to a melee attacker it stops.
sea_slayer: amount = damage a fully charged hit adds against sea creatures (#arsenal:sea_creatures).
ignite: amount = seconds a fully charged hit sets the target on fire for.
fireproof: the item won't burn up in fire or lava, like netherite (amount is ignored).
self_repair: amount = durability mended every 5 seconds while carried or worn (not while broken).
shot_guard: amount = share taken off shots and other projectiles, added up over worn pieces (at most 40%).

upgrades.name: Honed Edge
upgrades.description: +0.75 attack damage per level. Stacks with a whetstone's grade.

upgrades.name: Kokuto Inlay
upgrades.description: Black steel that carries Haki: with Armament Haki on, 10% of each hit per level goes through armor.

upgrades.name: Rifled Bore
upgrades.description: Grooves cut down the barrel: +15% range and 25% less spread per level.

upgrades.name: Powder Chamber
upgrades.description: A bigger charge: +1.5 damage per shot per level.

upgrades.name: Waxed Lock
upgrades.description: Keeps the powder dry and the lock smooth: 10% faster reload per level.

upgrades.name: Tide-Runner Soles
upgrades.description: +5% speed on land and +15% in water per level.

upgrades.name: Spiked Boss
upgrades.description: A spike in the middle of the shield: a melee hit it stops pricks the attacker for 1.5 damage per level.

upgrades.name: Fang Edge
upgrades.description: A Sea King's fang set into the edge: +1 attack damage per level, and fully charged hits deal 3 more per level to sea creatures.

upgrades.name: Ambergris Polish
upgrades.description: Island Whale ambergris worked into the metal and leather: mends 2 durability every 5 seconds while carried or worn. Broken gear still needs the anvil.

upgrades.name: Heartstone Core
upgrades.description: A Punk Hazard Dragon's heartstone set in the hilt: fully charged hits set the target on fire for 4 seconds, and the weapon won't burn up in fire or lava. Grand Line Anvil only.

upgrades.name: Pacifista Core
upgrades.description: On a gun: +2 damage per shot and a 15% faster reload. On armor: +0.1 knockback resistance, and 8% off shots per piece (at most 40%).
